name: agy_write_context_file
description: Antigravity CLI write_file at an agent instruction file. The escalation is emitted as force_ask, not ask, because a measured run against Antigravity CLI 1.5.3 in headless print mode showed the tool call RAN when the hook answered ask, and was refused when it answered force_ask.

capture.sanitisation: session ids, transcript paths, model names and tool_use ids replaced with cap-* placeholders; tool names and parameter names and their casing are exactly as emitted
